items.note: 伦敦圣詹姆斯合作社在小学教室开社员大会，听取委员会报告。合作社的运动场所常是学校与酒馆——这决定了谁能来、谁不能来。

items.title: 「招聘」一则讽刺
items.text: WANTED. An Editor, who according to his correspondents is not always ready to assist the injured and oppressed, and use his powerful influence' to suppress every real and imaginary grievance. _ _ New-siaper Correspondent, who does not want a corner for his effusions, or who does not apologise for trespassing on the valuable space. A Gentl
items.note: 标题写 WANTED（招聘），内容却是在讥讽一位编辑。工人报纸的幽默与派系论战混在同一栏，读的时候要分清哪句是事实、哪句是挖苦。

items.note: 转自医学报的报道，讲病牛进入市场。工人报纸转载公共卫生新闻，说明「工资—物价—食品安全」在他们眼里是同一件事。

items.title: 铁路工人代表会议
items.text: TIIII RAILWAY EMPLOYE, On Monday forenoon, in accordance with the decision arrived at on Sunday afternoon, eleven dele- gates—namely, one from each of the following towns, Wakefield, Mirfield, Bury, Leeds, Oldham Road (Manchester), Salford, Blackburn, Preston, Liverpool, Bolton, and Accrington—waited upon Mr. Thorley, traffic manager of t
items.note: 十一个城镇各派一名代表开会。能列出城镇名单，说明 1872 年工会已有跨地区协调能力——这是组织化程度的直接证据，比任何口号都硬。

items.title: 缝纫机厂工人年会
items.text: MENEM TO SEWING MACHINE EMPLOYES. The employes of Mesas. Newton, Wilson and Co., held their annual gathering on Saturday, at the White Horse Hotel, Congreve-street, where the operatives in the employment of the above firm, at the Smeaton Works, Pope-street, partook of an excellent dinner. About one hundred persons wore present, the head o
items.note: 在白马旅馆开年会。注意地点：工人组织的日常活动发生在酒馆，而不是会堂——这既是资源限制，也是当时结社的实际形态。

items.note: 报纸自己列了「七项要求」，并说工人阶级「命运在自己手里」。这是宣传语，不是事实陈述；要与同期实际立法进展分开看。

items.title: 棉荒下的合作社
items.text: ! CO-OPERATIVE INTELLI- GENCE. The distress in the manufacturing districts has seri- ously affected the receipts of the trade and, friendly societies, but the co-operative societies have suffered most. The members are unable to meet their monthly calls, and the general poverty prevents any sale of shares, and the scrip is at present almos
items.note: 报道说制造业区困难使工会与互助会收入下降，而合作社受损最重。1862 年兰开夏棉荒的冲击，是通过会费与股金这两条线传导到工人组织的。
